bio: I am a doctoral candidate in Organizational Behavior at HBS. Before this, I lived in Jerusalem, Israel, where I studied for a master’s in sociology while my wife clerked for the Supreme Court. Before that, I worked as a computer programmer, but that seems like a lifetime ago. Having spent most of my life in the Middle East, I have had my share of warm, humid weather, and I find Cambridge’s climate absolutely wonderful (don’t let others convince you otherwise!). My passions (research notwithstanding) are hardcore nerdy. Computers, tabletop games, D&D, photography, and miniature painting. my favorite letter is R (you'll get it once you take stats ;)). Finally, my actual favorite pursuit is playing with my two children. My family and I are excited to meet you all! Community Yards Elm Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
